name.zh: Rhenium Garry's Mod 服务端系统题（五题正式版）

description.en: Five server-authoritative clean-room GMod tasks for Sandbox on gm_flatgrass.
description.zh: 面向 Sandbox/gm_flatgrass 的服务端权威 clean-room GMod 五题。

summary.en: Canonicalize, persist and restore an entity/constraint graph.
summary.zh: 规范化、持久化并恢复实体/约束图。

brief.en: Use public duplicator, constraint and Undo APIs with full rollback.
brief.zh: 用公开 duplicator、constraint、Undo API 实现全回滚。

en: [T5-DATA-02] Enforce the closed entity class and model allowlists.
[T5-DATA-03] Enforce the Weld/NoCollide constraint allowlist and valid endpoints.
[T5-DATA-04] Enforce budgets of 8 blueprints, 16 entities, and 24 constraints.
[T5-SEM-01] Assign stable local entity IDs independently of input order.
[T5-HASH-01] Produce a behavioral canonical hash from normalized fields.
[T5-SEM-07] Deduplicate capture and paste-plan requests with revisions.
[T5-PERSIST-01] Preserve schemas, requests, and paste results across restart.
[T5-ROLLBACK-01] Roll back every object on partial Paste or Undo failure.
zh: [T5-DATA-02] 强制封闭的实体 class/model allowlist。
[T5-DATA-03] 强制 Weld/NoCollide constraint allowlist 与有效端点。
[T5-DATA-04] 强制 8 blueprint、16 entity、24 constraint 预算。
[T5-SEM-01] 独立于输入顺序分配稳定 local entity ID。
[T5-HASH-01] 从规范字段生成行为定义的 canonical hash。
[T5-SEM-07] 结合 revision 去重 capture 与 paste-plan 请求。
[T5-PERSIST-01] 跨重启保留 schema、request 与 paste 结果。
[T5-ROLLBACK-01] 部分 Paste 或 Undo 失败时回滚全部对象。

en: [T5-NATIVE-04] Register all restored objects in one Undo unit.
[T5-NATIVE-05] Assign restored Props with cleanup.Add without internal APIs.
zh: [T5-NATIVE-01] 使用公开 duplicator.Copy 捕获。
[T5-NATIVE-02] 使用公开 constraint.GetTable 检查约束。
[T5-NATIVE-03] 使用公开 duplicator.Paste 恢复。
[T5-NATIVE-04] 将全部恢复对象登记为一个 Undo 单元。
[T5-NATIVE-05] 用 cleanup.Add 归属恢复 Prop，不调用内部 API。

en: A real three-node two-edge graph canonicalizes within exact allowlists and budgets.
Malformed graphs fail before mutation and owner views remain detached.
Replay, revisions, paste records, and two-process persistence remain stable.
Public Copy/GetTable/Paste plus one Undo restore and remove the graph.
Partial failures fully roll back and shutdown leaves no lifecycle residue.
zh: 真实三节点两边图在精确 allowlist 与预算内完成规范化。
恶意图在修改前失败，owner 视图保持 detached。
重放、revision、paste 记录与两进程持久化保持稳定。
公开 Copy/GetTable/Paste 与一个 Undo 可恢复并移除图。
部分失败完全回滚，关闭后无生命周期残留。
